Here is the plan for the release this week. First, we finish the voice work, because the team has been waiting for it and the design is already approved. The live preview should show the words above the pill while the user is talking, and the final text should be ready as soon as they press the key again. Second, we clean up the settings page. Some of the labels are too long, and two of the switches do the same thing, so we should merge them into one. Third, we look at the startup time. The app takes almost three seconds to show the first window on an older laptop, and most of that time is spent loading data we do not need yet. If we load it later, the window should appear much faster. Finally, we write the release notes and send them to the support team before Friday, so they know what changed and can answer questions from users. If anything slips, tell me early, and we can move it to the next release instead of rushing it. I would rather ship fewer things that work well than many things that break on the first day. Thanks, everyone, for the hard work this month.
